messages.subject: mentoring for Google Code-In?
messages.body_plain:
Hi GSOC mentors,

I am working on an application for R project in Google Code-In, which is similar to GSOC, but for high school students. The project ideas need to be small tasks (each doable in about a day) suitable for high school students. No developing new R packages from scratch. But some appropriate ideas would be
- closing issues
- fixing simple bugs
- updating documentation
- setting up pkgdown web pages for projects that don't already have it
- setting up CI for projects that don't already have it
etc

Mentor responsibilities are listed on
https://developers.google.com/open-source/gci/help/responsibilities#mentor_responsibilities

If you would be interested to participate as a mentor, can you please write me an email, so I can get an idea about how many mentors with previous GSOC experience may be available?
